info.title: NUS SoC AI Gateway — client API
info.description: Local app API contract. Use your gateway app key, not the dashboard token or a provider credential. Availability comes from GET /v1/models. Documentation describes the common input forms and connector-specific restrictions; it does not imply full OpenAI API compatibility.

get.description: Returns only models with successful endpoint checks for the current account. Empty data means no verified models are available yet. Discover and verify candidates in the dashboard before using them. Counts include aliases and reasoning variants.

200.description: Successful result. Examples are illustrative; IDs, usage and data vary by account.

post.description: Choose a model that advertises this endpoint. Additional request fields are forwarded to ChatGPT/SoCLaaS and may be rejected upstream. Gemini accepts text only; it rejects tools, image/audio input, sampling controls and token limits. Inspect streamed errors even when HTTP status is 200. Gemini CLI generation is limited to 300 seconds, with a 315-second wrapper deadline. Set client timeouts to at least 330 seconds. Empty output fails with empty_model_response; deadlines fail with upstream_timeout.

get.description: WebSocket handshake, not an ordinary GET. Use ws://localhost:4000/v1/realtime?model=URL_ENCODED_ID with an Authorization Bearer header. JSON events are relayed; model changes and binary frames are rejected. Maximum session: 15 minutes; frame/buffer limit: 16 MiB. Revoking a key blocks new connections, not an existing session. Native browser WebSocket constructors cannot set the required header.
